verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support article title, 'Turn on Live Captions', which shows a built-in accessibility tool exists. Nothing in the pack mentions a built-in screen reader or using accessibility tools during first-run setup, so support is thin. Keyboard shortcuts and Quick Assist are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in screen reader, accessibility options available during installation/OOBE, a broader set of accessibility tools (magnifier, high contrast, etc.), in-depth docs, and independent corroboration.
